rule_or_requirement: Pixel-only inference must finish before lap time determines ranking; the selected policy is reliable but too slow for public third-place records.
observable_information: Training-only speed, route alignment and simulator outcomes plus pixel observations; inference receives pixels only.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Continue the fixed selected PPO checkpoint with a larger throttle action range and current speed-shortfall/curve shaping on TRAIN maps only.
expected_success_endpoint: First, TRAIN rollout activates higher throttle and controlled corner speed; then fresh matched tune completes at least as often as full-road-guard and improves tied median finished lap time.
control: Full-road-guard selected ZIP and its source checkpoint; identical fresh tune cells for any submission-candidate comparison.
falsifier: No meaningful increase in learned throttle/speed, TRAIN completion collapse, or lower finish rate than the matched control on fresh tune.
smallest_decisive_experiment: 4096 TRAIN environment decisions, four PPO updates, then only if activated a 12-cell matched tune on tracks 1-3 seeds 284-287.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 3600-second training limit; read-only exact legacy checkpoint hash; no tune geometry in learning; no website upload.
